item.text: For a non-empty topic, `get_relevant_context` currently does a pure-symbolic lookup against the cache-coherent entity index via `entity_index.search_classes()`, then filters topic hits by the relevance floor before returning them. It does not use an LLM on the retrieval path. I relied on the recorded entries “get_relevant_context: pure-symbolic context retrieval via entity index (topic) or list-all (no topic)” and “get_relevant_context: relevance floor (0.45) drops noise hits; topic-aware empty-state is honest”.
